title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 41, Chapter 10 - Payment of Wages
source_id: S.C. Code Ann. tit. 41, ch. 10 (secs. 41-10-10 to 41-10-110)
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 41 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title41.php): title 'Title 41 - Labor and Employment', chapter row 'CHAPTER 10 - PAYMENT OF WAGES' with no [REPEALED] marker (sibling chapters do carry that marker where it applies, e.g. Title 38's 'CHAPTER 95 ... [REPEALED]'); then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t41c010.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 10 / Payment of Wages' and which runs from SECTION 41-10-10 (Definitions) to SECTION 41-10-110. Currency taken from the register's Code index: 'The South Carolina Code on the General Assembly's website is now current through the 2025 Session of the General Assembly.'
notes: The South Carolina Payment of Wages Act: notification of wages and hours, permitted deductions, medium and timing of payment, wages due on discharge (sec. 41-10-50), and the treble-damages remedy. Minimum wage is not set by South Carolina statute at all - the state has no minimum wage law, so the federal FLSA rate applies; Title 41, Chapter 6 (Subminimum Wages) was verified in force on the same index but deals only with subminimum rates.
